fullContent:
Bilva Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Bilva (Bael) Thailam is an herbal oil used in Ayurvedic treatment of ear disorders such as hearing problems etc. Bael is the main component of this formulation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Bilva (Aegle marmelos) 
 Cow urine 
 Ajaksheera (Goat milk) 
 Til oil (sesame seed oil) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 First grind bael fruit in cow’s urine and form a pulp like consistency. Cook in a pan on low flame and when the pulp starts turning red put off the flame and filter it quickly. 
 Dosage 
 Drop 2 to 4 drops in your ear with a dropper. 
 Indications 
 
 Ear pain 
 Hearing loss 
 Tinnitus 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 The technical procedures should be done under professional guidance. 
 It does not have any side effects on external applications. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
